blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — After Caitlin Viray nailed the game-winning attack, an emotional Deanna Wong dropped to the taraflex and pounded the floor in celebration, fired up after Choco Mucho’s big win over longtime tormentor and sister team Creamline. Wong then shared a high five with her partner, Akari star Ivy Lacsina, before her teammates rushed in to pull her into a group hug as the Flying Titans finally overcame a major obstacle with a 23-25, 25-13, 25-23, 22-25, 15-13 victory to keep their semifinal hopes alive in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Thursday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. “As […]...
